free_text: Although the prior positive biopsy suggests deferral, the rising PSA velocity of 2.26 ng/mL/yr and the presence of a PI-RADS 4 lesion warrant re-evaluation per the guideline criterion. The evidence retrieved shows the PSA trend rising from 3.5 ng/mL to 5.3 ng/mL, which, combined with the PI-RADS 4 finding, suggests the need to re-characterize the lesion. The conference resolved the conflict by leaning toward sampling because the retrieved data indicated a change in clinical status despite the prior diagnosis.
